claim: NVIDIA announced on 30 Oct 2026 that JetPack 5.1.8 (Jetson Linux R35.7) is the final JetPack 5 release with 'no longer ... any critical updates'; Jetson AGX Xavier and Xavier NX are EoL on 5.1.8; Orin users are directed to JetPack 7.2.1; ongoing JetPack 5 maintenance is referred to ecosystem partner RidgeRun.

NVIDIA announced on 22 Nov 2024 that JetPack 4.6.6 is the final JetPack 4 release (Nano, TX2, TX1) and 'you will no longer receive any critical updates', referring further maintenance to ecosystem partners.

NVIDIA security bulletin 5716 (Oct 2025, rev 14 Jan 2026) lists fixed versions for CVE-2025-33182/33177 only on Jetson Linux 35.6.3, 36.4.7 and 38.2.2 (plus IGX); it does not mention Nano, TX1/TX2, r32 or JetPack 4.
NVIDIA Jetson lifecycle page (accessed 2026-11-10) lists Jetson Nano available through January 2027, TX2 NX and TX2i through July 2027, AGX Xavier 32GB/Industrial and Xavier NX through July 2027.

NVIDIA Jetson FAQ says Jetson AGX Xavier and Xavier NX modules remain available 'up to January 2028' (AGX Xavier Industrial July 2031), which conflicts with the lifecycle page's July 2027; the FAQ states no security-update period for any JetPack release.

NVIDIA forum thread (15 Oct 2025) on the CVE-2025-33182/33177 releases: users reported camera regressions on 36.4.7, NVIDIA acknowledged on 1 Dec 2025 that the CVE-2025-33177 fix 'triggers a side effect', and in Jan 2026 users still reported no 36.4.7 tarballs on the Linux Archive. [source: community forum]

Canonical (3 Jul 2025): Ubuntu Pro ESM covers the JetPack 4 Ubuntu 18.04 userspace until 2028, but 'the JetPack 4 kernel (based on the Linux kernel 4.9) remains outside of the scope of the service'; migration is the long-term path. [source: vendor]

siderolabs/pkgs PR #1518 (open Apr-Nov 2026, approved 2 Nov 2026) runs Orin GPU on mainline only via out-of-tree nvgpu plus unreleased OE4T sources ('None have release tags'); GA10B firmware is not in linux-firmware ('NVIDIA has never submitted the Orin GPU firmware there'); on kernel 7.3 it needed patches and GPU inference was ~7x slower than on 6.18. [source: community forum]
NVIDIA BYOK page (r39.2.1) names no tested or supported upstream kernel versions and lists no unavailable features; it notes listed patches may need prerequisite patches or adjustments.
kernel.org longterm releases (accessed 2026-11-10): 6.18 and 6.12 to Dec 2028, 6.6 and 6.1 to Dec 2027, 5.15 and 5.10 to Dec 2026; 6.8 is not a longterm release.
